name: Corrode Dart
description: Flick a bead of corroding qi that eats a pit into armor or skin on contact.

name: Etch Palm
description: Press a palm of etching qi on the foe's guard and leave a smoking mark that weakens it.

name: Bitter Skin
description: Cover the skin in a thin acid film that burns the hands of anyone who grips it.

name: Pit Edge
description: Pit the edge of a weapon with corroding qi so it chips on the next clash.

name: Eating Venom
description: Pierce a gap in the guard with venom that eats outward from the wound for many breaths.

name: Acid Screen
description: Raise a screen of acid mist that eats arrows, thrown blades and the edges of weapons.

name: Ruin Venom
description: Grip the foe and pour corroding venom through the palm to eat guard and flesh together.

name: Pitting Rain
description: Sprinkle a rain of corroding drops over a wide arc that pits armor and skin alike.

name: Plague Seed
description: Throw a seed of sickly qi that lodges in the foe's breath and spreads a mild fever.

name: Fever Touch
description: Touch the foe's brow and leave a mild fever that climbs through the body.

name: Mask Breath
description: Filter each breath through a thin veil of qi to keep sickly air out of the lungs.

name: Sick Sense
description: Sense the sickness in a crowd from the sour smell it leaves on the air.

name: Contagion Mark
description: Mark a foe with a spreading toxin that jumps to the others standing close to them.

name: Fever Veil
description: Spread a fevered haze that slows and sickens everyone who breathes it for several breaths.

name: Taint Hold
description: Close a contagion mark inside one body so it can spread no further.

name: Plague Tide
description: Gather sickly qi for a breath and release it as a rolling tide that sickens all within a wide arc.

name: Tainted Seed
description: Seed the earth with a taint that sickens whoever treads on it for a long while.

name: Miasma Taste
description: Spread a thin field of venom qi round the body to taste any toxin that touches it.

name: Miasma Barb
description: Turn a blow's force back through a barb of venom drawn from the field.

name: Venom Drift
description: Drift through the field's mist to cover a few paces without crossing the gap.

name: Miasma Needle
description: Draw a needle from the field and loose it at the target.

name: Miasma Bind
description: Thicken the field round a foe so it clings to the limbs and drags at each step.

name: Miasma Burn
description: Burn off toxins that enter the field before they can reach the skin.

name: Spreading Miasma
description: Expand the venom field in a wide ring so all inside feel a burning that grows each breath.

name: Toxin Harvest
description: Pull the toxins floating in the field back into the user's body as raw strength.

name: Twin Prick
description: Prick two points on the foe at once with paired fingertips of venom.

name: Paired Ward
description: Hold two crossed guards of venom qi so a blow meets one and the other answers.

name: Dual Step
description: Step with each foot along its own line of qi and land beside the foe.

name: Twin Taste
description: Taste poison in the air through both nostrils at once to find which way it drifts.

name: Twin Fang
description: Sink two fangs of venom into neighboring points so the toxin runs together under the skin.

name: Twin Cleanse
description: Take a poison from an ally into the right hand and let it out of the left as clear qi.

name: Azure Mist
description: Breathe out a pale blue mist that makes the foe see two of the user.

name: Paired Venom
description: Strike with both hands on the same beat so the venom meets in the middle of the foe's body.

name: Hawk Sting
description: Rise on a held breath and drop onto the foe with a hawk's sting that sinks venom deep.

name: Azure Dart
description: Loose a dart of pale blue venom qi that streaks in a flat line to the foe's chest.

name: Hawk Poisoneye
description: Sharpen the eyes to see the faint sheen of venom on a blade, a cup or a needle.

name: Talon Prick
description: Hook the fingers like talons and rake a venom mark across the foe's forearm.

name: Wing Screen
description: Sweep both arms out like wings to turn a thrust aside with a flick of venom.

name: Pale Venomhaze
description: Breathe a pale blue haze over the foes that dulls their reflexes and weighs their limbs.

name: Hawk Glide
description: Glide low and fast along the line of the foe's guard to land at the open side.

name: Stooping Venom
description: Rise on a breath and drop onto the foe as a hawk stoops, driving venom through the guard.

name: Azure Bloom
description: Gather azure venom qi for a moment and let it bloom outward in a broad flower of stinging mist.

name: Antidote Reading
description: Taste a poisoned cup through the nose to tell which draught will treat it.

name: Antitoxin Touch
description: Lay two fingers on an ally's wound and ease the swelling and the burn.

name: Paired Salve
description: Rub salves of warm and cool qi into an ally's bite until both fever and chill fade.

name: Opposing Skin
description: Match an entering toxin with its opposite on the skin so the two cancel out.

name: Bitter Counter
description: Throw a bitter bead at a foe's hand while it mixes a dose to spoil the brew.

name: Toxin Pull
description: Draw a slow poison from an ally's blood into the user's palm, cooling it as it leaves.

name: Dual Antidote
description: Weave two opposed counter currents through a poisoned ally to break a double dose at once.

name: Tonic Surge
description: Surge a bright tonic through an ally's limbs to lift their strength against fatigue.

name: Balm Rain
description: Gather healing qi for a breath and let it fall as a fine balm on every ally close to the user.

name: Bane Breaker
description: Break a strong poison inside an ally in one pressed palm and push the last of it out.

name: Oath Dart
description: Send a dart of venom qi along the line of sight as if sworn to reach the mark.

name: Vowbound Skin
description: Hold a guard of venom qi and keep faith with it until the last blow lands.

name: Bearing Step
description: Take a bearing on the foe and step straight toward it, trailing a thread of toxin.

name: Wind Taste
description: Taste the wind for poison and read from which side it comes.

name: Oath Venom
description: Bind a strike to the foe by a venom oath so the toxin clings through each dodge.

name: Open Veil
description: Open a broad veil of mist on the wind so the foes lose their bearing.

name: Sworn Bite
description: Drive a venom bite through the guard and keep the wound open with a hooked thread of qi.

name: Wind Fume
description: Gather venom fume for a breath and loose it on the wind across a broad front.

name: Steady Dose
description: Take a measured dose of toxin to steel the body for the fight ahead.

name: Dose Flick
description: Flick a measured dose at the throat from arm's length.

name: Dormant Guard
description: Wear a plain guard of venom qi that shows nothing until a hand touches it.

name: Hinge Bearing
description: Hold a bearing on the foe through a sidestep and finish the step facing true.

name: Keen Dose
description: Strike a nerve cluster with a keen dose that locks the limb for a few breaths.

name: Wind Shroud
description: Draw a shroud of toxic wind round a foe that weighs on the chest and slows each breath.

name: Oath Purge
description: Swear to carry an ally's poison and draw it out through the user's own breath.

name: Venom Reckoning
description: Reckon the foe's weak point and drive a venom spike straight there on a single breath.

name: Sworn Cloud
description: Hold a broad cloud of venom qi over the foes and draw it tighter with each breath.

name: Patient Prick
description: Wait for the opening and prick it with a narrow thread of venom.

name: Oath Skin
description: Make the skin a sworn guard that turns thin venom back on those who use it.

name: Long Sense
description: Spread a long field of senses to feel for toxins and breathing bodies a stone's throw away.

name: Hushed Slither
description: Step without a sound on a cushion of damp qi so the foe hears nothing.

name: Slow Oath
description: Swear a slow venom into the foe and let it sink in stage by stage over the next breaths.

name: Seed Mark
description: Plant a seed of venom that blooms only when the foe strikes, breaking their rhythm.

name: Vow Toxin
description: Sink a vowed toxin into the foe through the neck, one that grows with each heartbeat until spent.

name: Patient Miasma
description: Hold a still field of venom qi wide round the user that grows denser while no one is hurt.
